text.p: Intermedia Communications Inc said on Friday it has completed its previously announced private placement of $300 million of 13-1/2 percent series A redeemable exchangeable preferred stock.
The preferred stock has a mandatory redemption at March 31, 2009, and is not convertible into common, Intermedia said.

Dividends for the preferred stock will accumulate at the rate of 13-1/2 percent from the date of issuance and are payable in additional shares of the preferred stock or cash for the first five years, the company said.
Proceeds will be used for accelerated expansion of Intermedia's addressable market by increasing the number of local/long distance voice and data switches in its network, Intermedia said.
